mapper.select:
select `id`, `parent_id`, `parent_path`, `code`, `name`, `sort_no`, `leader_user_id`, `level`, `remark`, `status`, `create_time`, `update_time` from sys_dept
`status` = #{dto.status}
and `name` like concat('%',#{dto.name},'%')
and `code` like concat('%',#{dto.code},'%')
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
order by `sort_no` asc
